method: User action to observed destination/result DOM plus two animation frames, including driver overhead; upper bound, not physical scanout. Setup, reset and sign-in excluded. Forward completion uses in-page removal plus two frames; driver-observed durations are retained separately. Local server only; no injected network delay.
scoreDefinition: Percentage of the complete interaction inventory with paired pooled p50 below 150 ms; null if any item is unmeasured
